release_notes: YouTube Manager's yellow recommendation card now stays aligned with Growth Autopilot and always recommends the next full quiz rather than reverting to a Short after refresh.
The recommendation uses the same performance-weighted category plan as Generate + Autopilot, so the dashboard and production workflow now agree on what to create next.
Legacy YouTube refreshes can no longer overwrite the Growth recommendation with the old Short/full-video balancing rule.
The working long-form Growth Analytics table, watch-time metrics, retention scoring and category learning remain unchanged.
